تختتمين (form VIII)
# تَخْتَتِمِينَ (taḵtatimīna) /tax.ta.ti.miː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of اِخْتَتَمَ (iḵtatama)
# تُخْتَتَمِينَ (tuḵtatamīna) /tux.ta.ta.miː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of اِخْتَتَمَ (iḵtatama)
